faqs.question: Where is MSK Institute located in Shikohabad?
faqs.answer: MSK Institute Shikohabad is situated at Gali No. 3, Near Gyan Jyoti Public School, Shikohabad, Uttar Pradesh (PIN: 283135). It is centrally accessible from Station Road, Katra Bazar, and nearby towns like Sirsaganj and Jasrana.

faqs.question: What are the lab timings and operating hours at Shikohabad branch?
faqs.answer: The campus and computer lab are open Monday through Saturday from 08:00 AM to 07:00 PM, and Sundays from 10:00 AM to 02:00 PM. Students enjoy extended practice lab hours beyond lecture timings.

faqs.question: Can I attend a free demo class before enrolling at Shikohabad campus?
faqs.answer: Yes! We offer 2 days of free demo classes across all programming and computer diploma courses. You can book an appointment online or walk directly into the campus counseling desk.

faqs.question: Are offline certificates verified online from this branch?
faqs.answer: All certificates awarded upon course completion at MSK Institute Shikohabad come with tamper-proof QR codes and can be instantly verified globally at mskinstitute.in/verify-certificate.
